WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('127' AS TINYINT)
                       WHEN 1 THEN CAST('-128' AS TINYINT)
                       WHEN 2 THEN CAST('127' AS TINYINT)
                       WHEN 3 THEN CAST('-128' AS TINYINT)
                       WHEN 4 THEN CAST('127' AS TINYINT)
                       WHEN 5 THEN CAST('-128' AS TINYINT)
                       WHEN 6 THEN CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)
                       ELSE CAST(i AS TINYINT) END AS lhs,
           CAST(CASE id WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN -1 WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 3 THEN 1
                        WHEN 4 THEN 2 WHEN 5 THEN -1 WHEN 7 THEN NULL ELSE p END AS TINYINT) AS rhs
    FROM bench WHERE id < 10
)
SELECT id, TRY_ADD(lhs,rhs) AS add_result, TRY_SUBTRACT(lhs,rhs) AS subtract_result, TRY_MULTIPLY(lhs,rhs) AS multiply_result
FROM operands

SELECT id,
    TRY_ADD(CAST(i AS TINYINT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS TINYINT)) AS r_tinyint_try_add,
    TRY_SUBTRACT(CAST(i AS TINYINT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS TINYINT)) AS r_tinyint_try_subtract,
    TRY_MULTIPLY(CAST(i AS TINYINT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS TINYINT)) AS r_tinyint_try_multiply,
    TRY_ADD(CAST(i AS SMALLINT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS SMALLINT)) AS r_smallint_try_add,
    TRY_SUBTRACT(CAST(i AS SMALLINT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS SMALLINT)) AS r_smallint_try_subtract,
    TRY_MULTIPLY(CAST(i AS SMALLINT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS SMALLINT)) AS r_smallint_try_multiply,
    TRY_ADD(CAST(i AS INT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS INT)) AS r_int_try_add,
    TRY_SUBTRACT(CAST(i AS INT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS INT)) AS r_int_try_subtract,
    TRY_MULTIPLY(CAST(i AS INT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS INT)) AS r_int_try_multiply,
    TRY_ADD(CAST(i AS BIGINT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS BIGINT)) AS r_bigint_try_add,
    TRY_SUBTRACT(CAST(i AS BIGINT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS BIGINT)) AS r_bigint_try_subtract,
    TRY_MULTIPLY(CAST(i AS BIGINT), CAST(p % 2 + 1 AS BIGINT)) AS r_bigint_try_multiply
FROM bench WHERE id < 12

SELECT id,
    TRY_ADD(i,1L) AS array_scalar, TRY_SUBTRACT(1L,i) AS scalar_array,
    TRY_MULTIPLY(2L,3L) AS scalar_scalar, TRY_ADD(CAST('9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT),1L) AS overflow
FROM bench WHERE id < 8

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE id WHEN 1 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE i END AS lhs,
           CASE id WHEN 1 THEN 'bad' ELSE '2' END AS raw
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, TRY_ADD(lhs,CAST(raw AS BIGINT)) AS result FROM operands

SELECT id, TRY_ADD(i,CAST(p AS BIGINT)) AS add_result,
    TRY_SUBTRACT(i,CAST(p AS BIGINT)) AS subtract_result, TRY_MULTIPLY(i,CAST(p AS BIGINT)) AS multiply_result
FROM bench WHERE id < 0
